peopleAlsoAsk.question: How serious is Shiga toxin?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: People infected with shiga toxin-producing E. coli can develop severe, bloody diarrhea and painful abdominal cramps. In some people, the infection can cause a condition known as hemolytic uremic syndrome (HUS) which results in acute kidney failure, and other complications such as seizures and stroke can occur.
